facts.text: On a 50 lakh rupee home loan across a standard tenure, cumulative interest payable can reach 45,93,875 rupees, bringing total outgo to 95,93,875 rupees.

facts.label: official

facts.text: Lenders cap the Loan-to-Value ratio at 80 percent for housing loans between 30 lakh rupees and 75 lakh rupees, requiring home buyers to contribute at least 20 percent as a margin.

facts.label: reported

facts.text: Prepaying one extra equated monthly instalment each year on a 50 lakh rupee home loan at 8.5 percent interest over 25 years saves approximately 18.31 lakh rupees in total interest.

facts.label: official

facts.text: Under Section 24(b) of the Income Tax Act, the maximum allowable tax deduction on interest paid for a self-occupied house property loan is 2,00,000 rupees per year.

facts.text: Under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, taxpayers can claim a maximum combined deduction of 1,50,000 rupees, which includes repayment of housing loan principal.

facts.text: On a 75 lakh rupee loan over 25 years at 8.0 percent, an annual prepayment strategy of one extra EMI reduces the tenure by 6 to 7 years and saves 24 to 25 lakh rupees in interest.

scenes.label: Ghar ka asli bill

visual.prompt: A shiny new set of flat keys on a wooden table beside a loan sanction file, behind it a towering mountain of cash bundles rising to the ceiling, dramatic evening light, wide 16:9 illustrated panel

scenes.vo: 50 lakh ka home loan, aur bank ko wapas 95,93,875 rupaye? Haan, yeh Bank of Baroda ke apne calculator ka hisaab hai. Matlab lagbhag double.

visual.prompt: A stream of rupee notes flowing out of a new apartment door and curving away into the open doors of a big bank building down the street, the apartment itself staying small and bare, afternoon light

scenes.vo: Ghar ek khareeda, par bill lagbhag dugna. Aur sabse bada jhatka abhi baaki hai. Shuru ke saalon ki EMI ka zyaadatar hissa ghar mein jaata hi nahi.

visual.prompt: BHAI in his hoodie happily handing out sweets from a box in a small rented living room, MUMMY in a saree smiling, PAPA in a kurta laughing, festive warm evening light

scenes.vo: Yeh kahani hai Bhai ki. Naukri pakki, shaadi ho chuki, aur sapna ek, apna flat. Bank Uncle ne loan pass kiya, aur ghar mein mithai baati gayi.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta resting a reassuring hand on BHAI's shoulder on a balcony, both looking at a half-built apartment tower in the distance, golden sunset

scenes.vo: Papa ne kandhe par haath rakha aur bole, bas EMI time par bharte rehna, baaki sab apne aap ho jaayega. Sabne maan liya. Lekin kya sach mein?

visual.prompt: Late night in a quiet bedroom, a printed bank statement lying open on a bedside table under a lamp, BHAI sitting up in bed in the background staring at the ceiling, worried, blue night tones

scenes.vo: Kyunki kuch saal baad, Bhai ne pehli baar apna loan statement dhyaan se khola. Aur jo dekha, us raat use neend nahi aayi. Kya tha usme?

visual.prompt: A giant glass jar labelled with no text, filled almost to the top with coins representing the loan, a tiny hand removing only a few coins while a big pipe drains other coins toward a bank, surreal illustrated style

scenes.vo: Itni EMI bhar di, phir bhi bacha hua udhaar lagbhag utna ka utna. Toh paisa gaya kahaan? Seedha bank ki jeb mein, byaaj ban kar.

visual.prompt: explaining_front

scenes.vo: Toh aaj teen sawaal. Pehla, 50 lakh ka loan lagbhag double kaise ban jaata hai? Doosra, pehle saalon mein ghar ka kitna hissa sach mein aapka hua?

visual.prompt: A wall calendar with many months, one single month glowing golden among the rest, a hand pinning an extra envelope of cash onto that glowing month, morning light in a home office

scenes.vo: Aur teesra, saal mein sirf ek extra EMI bharne se kitna byaaj aur kitne saal bachte hain? Teesre jawaab ke liye aakhir tak rukna, woh sabse kaam ka hai.

visual.prompt: Flashback panel with soft sepia tones: BHAI eagerly signing a thick stack of loan papers at a bank counter, BANK UNCLE behind the counter sliding more pages forward, busy bank branch daytime

scenes.vo: Par pehle chalte hain wahan, jahan yeh kahani shuru hui thi. Bank ki counter par, jahan Bhai ne khushi khushi har kaagaz par sign kiya tha.

scenes.label: Loan double kaise hota hai

visual.prompt: BANK UNCLE behind a wooden bank counter opening a fat loan file, explaining with one finger raised, BHAI and his wife seated across listening carefully, fluorescent bank interior, midday

scenes.vo: Bank Uncle ne file kholi. Pehli baat, ghar ki poori keemat bank nahi deta. Kam se kam 20 percent aapko apni jeb se dena padta hai.

visual.prompt: A miniature model house split into two parts, a small slice painted in the family's warm colours and the much larger rest in cold bank grey, sitting on a desk under a lamp

scenes.vo: Isse margin kehte hain, yaani ghar mein aapka apna hissa. Baaki sab bank ka udhaar. Aur asli kahani isi udhaar se shuru hoti hai.

visual.prompt: Close view of neat bundles of cash being pushed across a bank counter toward BHAI's waiting hands, BANK UNCLE's hands on the other side, crisp daylight

scenes.vo: Bhai ke papers par likha tha, loan 50 lakh rupaye. Is asal udhaar ko principal kehte hain. Yaani woh paisa jo bank ne sach mein aapko diya.

visual.prompt: A cash bundle drawn like a rented house with a small meter ticking beside it, coins dropping out of the meter into a bank bag, playful illustrated concept panel

scenes.vo: Ab bank yeh paisa muft mein toh dega nahi. Udhaar ka bhi kiraya hota hai. Usi kiraye ko byaaj kehte hain, angrezi mein interest.

visual.prompt: A long road of identical stepping stones stretching to the horizon, each stone a monthly payment envelope, BHAI walking on the first few stones carrying an envelope, early morning mist

scenes.vo: In dono ko milaakar banti hai EMI. EMI yaani har mahine ki fixed kisht. Har mahine wahi raqam, 20 saal tak, bina ek bhi mahina chooke.

visual.prompt: BEHEN in office wear at a desk with a laptop, a desk calculator beside it, her eyebrows raised in disbelief, two equal tall stacks of cash drawn on the desk next to her, evening office light

scenes.vo: Ab Bank of Baroda ke calculator mein 50 lakh ka loan daalo. Akela byaaj aata hai 45,93,875 rupaye. Yaani lagbhag asal udhaar jitna hi.

visual.prompt: A balance scale on a table: one pan holds a small model flat, the other pan holds two equal towers of cash bundles tipping it down heavily, dramatic side light

scenes.vo: Socho zara. Aapne 50 lakh udhaar liye, aur upar se lagbhag utne hi bank ko kiraye mein de diye. Total bill ho gaya 95,93,875 rupaye.

visual.prompt: A big boulder of debt on a hillside with a small new pebble of interest added on top every month, a tiny figure pushing the boulder uphill, dusk sky

scenes.vo: Par aisa hota kyun hai? Byaaj sirf ek baar nahi lagta. Har mahine, jitna udhaar bacha hai, us poore par naya byaaj judta hai.

visual.prompt: An unnamed young tenant handing rent money to a landlord at a rented flat door, month after month shown as ghostly repeated copies of the same handover, warm hallway light

scenes.vo: Ise kiraye ke ghar jaisa samjho. Jab tak aap usme rehte ho, har mahine kiraya dete ho. Udhaar bhi waisa hi hai, jitni der rakho, utna kiraya.

visual.prompt: A time-lapse style panel of the same apartment window: a young couple at left, the same couple greying at right, a sapling outside growing into a tall tree, soft daylight

scenes.vo: Aur 20 saal bahut lambi der hai. Itne saal bank ka paisa aapke paas rehta hai. Isliye kiraya bhi itna bada ho jaata hai, lagbhag udhaar jitna.

visual.prompt: Inside a bank branch from a wide angle: depositors at one counter receiving money, staff working at desks, lights and computers humming, money flowing in and out like rivers, daytime

scenes.vo: Toh kya yeh poora byaaj bank ka munafa hai? Nahi. Bank ko bhi FD waalon ko byaaj dena hota hai, aur staff aur branch ka kharcha bhi uthana hota hai.

visual.prompt: A very long paper receipt unrolling from a kitchen table across the floor and out the door of a modest flat, MUMMY in a saree holding one end in surprise, morning light

scenes.vo: Lekin aapki jeb ke liye hisaab seedha hai. Ghar ka udhaar alag, aur upar se lagbhag utna hi byaaj. Yahi hai aapke ghar ka asli bill.

visual.prompt: BEHEN and BHAI sitting on the floor of the new empty flat with cardboard boxes around, BEHEN gesturing at the walls as if measuring them, late afternoon sun through the window

scenes.vo: Behen ne yeh number dekha toh boli, theek hai, byaaj zyada hai. Par har EMI ke saath ghar thoda thoda apna toh hota jaata hai na?

visual.prompt: A snail slowly painting a house wall in warm colour while most of the wall stays bank grey, a big clock ticking above, humorous illustrated panel, soft daylight

scenes.vo: Yahi sabse badi galatfehmi hai. Shuru ke saalon mein ghar bahut hi dheere apna hota hai. Kitna dheere? Par asli sawaal ab shuru hota hai.

scenes.label: Pehle saal ki EMI kahaan gayi

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Doosra sawaal. Pehle saalon mein aapki EMI ka kitna hissa ghar mein gaya, aur kitna bank ki jeb mein? Jawaab ek table mein chhupa hai.

visual.prompt: A long printed table of rows and columns spread across a dining table, drawn as two coloured columns, one thick red and one thin green, with a magnifying glass resting on it, lamplight, no readable text

scenes.vo: Is table ko amortisation schedule kehte hain. Naam mushkil, kaam seedha. Har EMI mein kitna byaaj gaya, kitna asal udhaar kata, sab likha hota hai.

visual.prompt: A dusty sealed envelope from the bank tucked deep in a drawer under old bills and warranty cards, a cobweb in the corner, dim cupboard light

scenes.vo: Bank yeh table deta hai, aksar app mein bhi mil jaata hai. Par zyaadatar log ise kabhi kholte hi nahi. Bhai ne bhi kabhi nahi khola tha.

visual.prompt: Twelve monthly payment envelopes laid out in a neat row on a table, a hand gathering them into one fat bundle, a curious question-shaped shadow on the wall, morning light

scenes.vo: Ab Bank of Baroda ka ek 20 saal ka schedule dekho. Pehle saal poore saal ki EMI bhari gayi, kul 2,28,000 rupaye. Ab andaaza lagao, isme byaaj kitna tha?

visual.prompt: The fat bundle of cash split by a knife: a huge chunk sliding into a bank's open bag, only a thin sliver falling into a small piggy bank shaped like a house, dramatic lighting

scenes.vo: Jawaab hai 1,82,261 rupaye. Yaani saal bhar ki EMI ka zyaadatar paisa seedha byaaj mein. Asal udhaar mein toh bahut thoda hi gaya.

visual.prompt: A jigsaw puzzle of a house on a table with only one tiny corner piece placed in warm colour and the rest still grey and missing, BHAI staring at it, evening

scenes.vo: Matlab poore saal EMI bharne ke baad bhi, udhaar lagbhag utna ka utna. Ghar ka bahut chhota sa hissa hi sach mein aapka hua.

visual.prompt: A giant hungry monster made of loan papers sitting on a mountain of debt, gobbling most of a plate of coins, a small figure holding the plate, cartoon style, daylight

scenes.vo: Aisa kyun? Shuru mein udhaar sabse bada hota hai. Toh us par byaaj bhi sabse bada banta hai. Aur EMI ka bada hissa wahi kha jaata hai.

visual.prompt: The same debt mountain shown shrinking over many seasons, the monster growing smaller each time, trees changing from summer to winter to spring in the background

scenes.vo: Jaise jaise udhaar ghatta hai, byaaj bhi ghatta hai. Tab EMI ka zyada hissa asal udhaar mein jaane lagta hai. Lekin yeh bahut saalon baad hota hai.

visual.prompt: A seesaw in a park: on the left end a heavy sack of interest pressing down at the start of a path, on the right end a light feather far down the path, golden afternoon

scenes.vo: Isi ko front-loaded byaaj kehte hain. Yaani bank apna kiraya shuru ke saalon mein hi zyada vasool karta hai. Aakhri saalon ki EMI zyaadatar asal chukaati hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI standing at the foot of a towering mountain shaped like a stack of paper, a small flag at the very bottom marking how far he has climbed, cold dawn light

scenes.vo: Ab samjhe, Bhai ko neend kyun nahi aayi? Kuch saal EMI bharne ke baad bhi, statement mein bacha hua udhaar pahaad jaisa dikh raha tha.

visual.prompt: A small paper boat carrying a model house floating on a choppy sea, waves rising and falling, a distant lighthouse shaped like a central bank building, stormy sky

scenes.vo: Aur ek khatra bhi tha. Bhai ka loan floating rate par tha. Floating rate yaani byaaj RBI ke faislon ke saath upar neeche hota rehta hai.

visual.prompt: The long road of payment stepping stones from before, now silently extending further over the horizon as new stones appear at the far end, BHAI looking back in alarm, dusk

scenes.vo: Byaaj badhe, toh bank aksar EMI nahi chhedta. Chupchaap loan ke saal badha deta hai. Aur lambe saal matlab, aur zyada mahine ka byaaj.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta sitting thoughtfully in an armchair with FD receipts on his lap, looking out of a window where a narrow sunlit path leads out of a dark maze, evening

scenes.vo: Toh sirf EMI time par bharna kaafi nahi hai. Papa ki baat aadhi hi sahi thi. Lekin is jaal se nikalne ka ek seedha raasta hai.

visual.prompt: MUMMY in a saree placing cups of chai on a small kitchen table, worried look, BEHEN across the table smiling confidently with a notebook, warm kitchen light at night

scenes.vo: Mummy ne chai rakhi aur poocha, toh kya hum 20 saal tak bas bank ka kiraya bharte rahenge? Behen muskurayi. Nahi Mummy, ek tareeka hai.

scenes.label: Ek extra EMI ka jaadu

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Teesra sawaal, aur sabse kaam ka. Agar saal mein sirf ek extra EMI bhar do, toh kya hoga? Jawaab sunkar aap shayad chaunk jaayenge.

visual.prompt: A hand dropping an extra envelope of cash straight into the debt boulder, which visibly cracks and loses a big chunk, bright morning light, energetic composition

scenes.vo: Isse prepayment kehte hain. Yaani time se pehle, apni marzi se, loan mein extra paisa jama karna. Yeh paisa seedha asal udhaar ko kam karta hai.

visual.prompt: A row of dominoes shaped like months falling one after another, each one smaller than the last, a sparkle at the end of the row, playful light

scenes.vo: Aur yahi iska jaadu hai. Asal udhaar kam hua, toh agle mahine se us par byaaj bhi kam lagega. Har mahine, loan ke aakhri din tak.

visual.prompt: A morning newspaper folded on a breakfast table next to a cup of tea, a pencil and a page of hand calculations beside it, soft window light, no readable text

scenes.vo: The Economic Times ne ek hisaab chhapa. 50 lakh ka loan, Bhai ke loan se thoda lamba. Bas saal mein ek extra EMI, aur kuch nahi badla.

visual.prompt: A big heap of cash bundles being rescued from the bank's bag and carried back into a family home by a cheerful line of tiny helpers, bright daylight

scenes.vo: Report ke mutabik, byaaj mein lagbhag 18.31 lakh rupaye bache. Socho, saal mein sirf ek extra kisht, aur lakhon rupaye ki bachat.

visual.prompt: The long road of payment stones now ending much earlier at a sunny garden gate, beyond it a school bag and a pair of reading glasses resting on a bench, golden light

scenes.vo: Aur loan bhi 5 saal se zyada pehle khatam. Yaani saalon tak koi EMI nahi. Woh paisa bachchon ki padhai ya budhape ke kaam aa sakta hai.

visual.prompt: A woodcutter's axe striking the thickest base of a huge tree trunk made of stacked papers, the tree starting to tilt, early morning forest light

scenes.vo: Itna bada fark kyun? Kyunki extra paisa shuru ke saalon mein jaata hai, jab udhaar sabse bada hai aur byaaj sabse zyada kaat raha hai.

visual.prompt: The seesaw from before now flipped, a family sitting happily on the raised end while the sack of interest slides off the other end, bright park afternoon

scenes.vo: Wahi front-loading jo ab tak aapke khilaaf thi, ab aapke saath kaam karti hai. Jitna jaldi prepay karo, utna zyada byaaj bachta hai.

visual.prompt: BHAI and BEHEN on a terrace at night with diyas glowing around them, BEHEN pointing to a small steel box where coins are being saved, festive Diwali lights

scenes.vo: Bhai ne Behen se poocha, par ek extra EMI aayegi kahaan se? Behen boli, Diwali ka bonus. Ya har mahine EMI ka thoda thoda hissa alag rakho.

visual.prompt: A glass jar on a kitchen shelf filling up month by month, shown as twelve small snapshots around it, the final jar full and glowing, cosy home light

scenes.vo: Saal ke aakhir tak ek EMI jitna paisa jud jaata hai. Woh seedha bank mein, prepayment ke naam par. Bas itna sa kaam, saal mein ek baar.

visual.prompt: PAPA in a kurta frowning with folded arms in the living room, an imagined thundercloud above him raining tiny fine slips, BHAI listening, evening lamplight

scenes.vo: Par Papa ko darr tha. Bank waale penalty toh nahi lagayenge? Pehle paisa lautaoge, toh unka byaaj ka nuksaan hoga na? Sawaal sahi tha.

visual.prompt: A grand central bank building with a giant shield standing in front of a small family home, the thundercloud of penalties bouncing off the shield, bright clearing sky

scenes.vo: Yahan RBI ka ek saaf niyam aapke kaam aata hai. Floating rate home loan par, banks prepayment ya loan jaldi band karne ki penalty nahi le sakte.

visual.prompt: BHAI standing tall at a bank counter placing an envelope down confidently, BANK UNCLE behind the counter nodding and accepting it, sunlight through the branch windows

scenes.vo: Yaani aapka loan floating rate par hai, toh extra paisa jama karne par bank koi penalty nahi maang sakta. Yeh aapka haq hai, bank ki meherbaani nahi.

visual.prompt: A hand writing a short letter with a fountain pen on a desk, beside it a pair of scissors cutting the long road of payment stones shorter, warm desk lamp, no readable text

scenes.vo: Ek baat dhyaan rakho. Prepay karte waqt bank ko likhkar bolo, EMI wahi rakho, loan ke saal kam karo. Byaaj ki zyaadatar bachat isi mein hai.

visual.prompt: The paper mountain of debt from before with a large chunk now missing, BHAI noticeably higher up the slope planting a small flag, a faint shadow of a question looming over the peak, morning

scenes.vo: Bhai ne usi hafte bank jaakar pehli extra EMI jama ki. Statement mein pehli baar udhaar sach mein kam dikha. Par ruko, ek galti abhi baaki hai.

scenes.label: Galti, tax aur aapka plan

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Ab woh galti jo bahut log karte hain. Woh sochte hain, home loan par tax toh bachta hai, phir jaldi chukaane ki kya zaroorat?

visual.prompt: A tax office counter drawn simply, an umbrella labelled with no text sheltering a small part of a cash pile from a rain of tax coins, office daylight

scenes.vo: Haan, tax ka fayda hai. Section 24(b) mein, apne rehne waale ghar ke loan ke byaaj par, saal mein 2,00,000 rupaye tak deduction milta hai.

visual.prompt: A shared basket on a table holding a model house, a savings passbook and an insurance folder squeezed together, the basket clearly full with no room left, soft light

scenes.vo: Deduction yaani itni income par tax nahi lagta. Asal udhaar chukaane par Section 80C mein bhi fayda hai, PPF jaisi cheezon ke saath milaakar 1,50,000 rupaye tak.

visual.prompt: Two doors side by side in a corridor, an old wooden door with a warm glow behind it and a sleek new door with an empty bare room behind it, a person pausing between them

scenes.vo: Par dhyaan do, yeh dono fayde purane tax system mein milte hain. Naye tax system mein apne rehne waale ghar par yeh deduction nahi milte.

visual.prompt: A bucket full of water with a big hole leaking into a bank drain, a small cup catching only a few drops labelled with no text, garden courtyard daylight

scenes.vo: Aur sabse badi baat. Tax mein jo bachta hai, woh byaaj ka sirf ek hissa hai. Bank ko diya baaki byaaj, phir bhi aapki jeb se hi gaya.

visual.prompt: explaining_front

scenes.vo: Toh aapke liye seedhi baat kya hai? Apna loan statement kholo. Dekho, is saal ki EMI mein kitna byaaj gaya, aur kitna asal udhaar kata.

visual.prompt: A loan agreement booklet open on a desk with one clause highlighted by a yellow marker glow, a magnifying glass over it, BEHEN's hand holding the marker, afternoon light, no readable text

scenes.vo: Phir check karo, aapka loan floating rate par hai ya fixed. Floating hai, toh prepayment par penalty ka sawaal hi nahi. Shaq ho, toh bank se likhit mein poocho.

visual.prompt: A sturdy small safe in a cupboard marked by a red cross symbol only, next to it a family's first aid box and a folder of papers, calm evening light

scenes.vo: Haan, prepay karne se pehle emergency ke liye kuch paisa alag zaroor rakho. Aur apne CA se tax ka hisaab bhi milaa lo, khaaskar purana ya naya system.

visual.prompt: A row of different homes along a street at dusk, a hut, a small flat, a bungalow, each with one lit window where a family studies a long table of papers

scenes.vo: Yeh investment advice nahi hai. Har ghar ki zaroorat alag hoti hai. Par ek baat har ghar par lagti hai, apni EMI ka table samajhna.

visual.prompt: BHAI, his wife, MUMMY and PAPA on the balcony of their own flat at sunset, the paper mountain in the distance now much smaller, everyone relaxed, warm golden light

scenes.vo: Bhai ki kahani yaad karo. 50 lakh ka loan, aur bill lagbhag double. Par ab use pata hai, EMI sirf bharni nahi hoti, samajhni bhi padti hai.

visual.prompt: pointing_right

scenes.vo: Agle video mein ek aur bada sawaal. Ghar khareedna behtar hai, ya kiraye par rehkar paisa bachana? Jawaab shayad aapki soch badal de.

visual.prompt: end_smile

scenes.vo: Aur ab aapse ek aasaan sawaal. Aapka home loan floating rate par hai ya fixed? Comments mein likho, floating ya fixed. Main padhunga.

script.title: 50 lakh ka home loan, bill *double* kyun? 🏠

hooks: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore kyun dete ho?
Pehli 5 saal ki EMI mein ghar ka kitna hissa aapka hua?
Saal mein ek extra EMI se kitne saal bachte hain?

intro.prompt: 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080, about 8 seconds, photorealistic and cinematic, bright vivid colour. Setting: inside a busy bank branch, customers at the counters and a short queue moving behind, daylight through tall windows. The background is real and in motion behind him (as fits the place: waves, mist, leaves, flags, lamps flickering, people walking, traffic, light shifting); never a still, flat or heavily blurred backdrop. Framing: medium shot from the waist up, his whole head and both shoulders inside the frame with clear space above his hair and on both sides, and he stays framed like this to the end; do not crop the top of his head. Lighting: warm key light on the face, a soft rim light on the hair, matched to the scene; flattering, no harsh shadows, no dull or flat grey look. SG [locked] standing relaxed and upright, shoulders open, wearing a dark green blazer over a cream shirt. Speaks from the first frame, mouth matched to the words, steady eye contact with the lens. Face and delivery: a confident, charismatic documentary presenter. Calm, natural face with a pleasant, warm smile, relaxed eyebrows, eyes soft and focused on the viewer. On "lagbhag ek crore ka" the eyes narrow a little with intrigue and the head tilts slightly, as if sharing a secret. On "Chaliye, hisaab dekhte hain" a warm, confident smile and one small nod. Natural blinking, subtle head movement. No exaggerated expressions: no wide eyes, no raised eyebrows, no open-mouth surprise, no big grin, no frown; never sad, gloomy, worried or tired. Voice: warm, clear, measured, with quiet intensity; a short pause before "lagbhag ek crore ka". Hands: one slow, small gesture toward the scene behind him on the first line, then hands rest; no fast or large arm movements. Camera: eye level, a very slight slow push-in, slight handheld feel. Empty hands, no prop. @SGLearning watermark in the top right corner, white, bold, 80% opacity. No captions, no subtitles, no other on-screen text. No hologram, no floating screen, no graph, no chart, no laptop, tablet, monitor, TV or glowing blue panel anywhere in the frame. Export at 1920x1080.
intro.question: Pachaas lakh ka ghar, bill lagbhag ek crore ka.
intro.text: Pachaas lakh ka ghar, bill lagbhag ek crore ka. Baaki paisa kahan gaya? Chaliye, hisaab dekhte hain.

topic.summary: A family buys a flat on a 20-year home loan; the amortisation schedule shows interest front-loaded, the total paid roughly double the price, and what prepaying one extra EMI a year does. Explain EMI, principal, interest, prepayment, floating rate.
topic.title: 50 lakh ka ghar, 1 crore ka bill: 20 saal ki EMI mein bank kitna kamata hai
